goals: Normalize local UTF-8 text files and save normalized output

functional_requirements.statement: Read a user-provided local UTF-8 text file
Write normalized text to a requested destination

quality_requirements.statement: Report input/output errors clearly without silently losing the original file

components.name: CLI application
components.boundary: Single local process; no network or background service required

components.name: Input reader
components.responsibility: Validate and read user-selected UTF-8 file
components.boundary: Input path, encoding and read errors

interfaces.name: read_input
interfaces.failure_behavior: Explicit error for unreadable or invalid input

quality_targets.NFR-001: Fail with a clear error without modifying the input

validation_evidence: Reviewed input boundary and expected read-error outcomes
components.stop_reason: Interface and error contract are specified

components.name: Text normalizer
components.boundary: Pure text transformation without filesystem access

components.name: Output writer
components.boundary: Destination path validation and safe file writing

quality_targets.NFR-001: Do not overwrite source file on failed write

validation_evidence: Reviewed output boundary and failure behavior

verification_cases.description: Review input handling and read-error behavior
verification_cases.evidence: Reviewed component interface and explicit failure behavior

decisions.title: Single-process architecture
decisions.rationale: Small local tool does not require services

findings.description: Confirm atomic write strategy before architecture approval
